escalation_condition: Suspected fracture, head impact with confusion, neck/spinal pain, deformity, or severe swelling
source: ITLS / Red Cross First Aid for Musculoskeletal and Spinal Trauma
approved_actions: Keep the injured person calm and still; do not move them if spinal, neck, or hip injury is suspected.
Support and immobilize the injured limb in the exact position found without attempting to straighten it.
Control any external bleeding with gentle surface pressure around broken bones.
Apply a cold pack wrapped in a cloth to reduce swelling for sprains, for up to 15 minutes.
Monitor vital alertness and keep the patient warm.
critical_actions: Do not move the patient if neck or back pain is suspected.
Immobilize the affected limb in place.
contraindications: Never attempt to re-align or force fractured bones back into place.
Never move a patient after a fall unless in imminent physical danger.
